_about: The kinds a document can be (the plan, phase 0), each with its meaning as the reader sees it, and the kinds for a text file that turns out not to be a document at all (ADR 0016: the reader says what a file in an unknown shape is). Kinds decided by rule for non-text files: image, design-file, archive, binary.

document.open-ledger: a list or table of open work items (a backlog, a to-do list, open issues), each with a status
document.finished-ledger: a list or table of finished or closed work items, moved out of the open ledger
document.change-log: dated entries of what landed or changed (a changelog, a release history, a gate history, a review log)
document.spec: a specification of one item, feature or module: objective, constraints, definition of done
document.adr: a recorded decision (an architecture decision record, a decision log entry with context, options and a decision)
document.plan: a plan, roadmap, milestone list or order of work
document.design: a design document, UX standard, mockup description or brand guide
document.evidence: a report of a run, a test, a measurement, a drive or a review that proves something
document.guide: instructions for people or tools working in the repository (README, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING, a skill, an agent definition, a how-to)
document.release-notes: notes for a release or version: what changed for users
document.report: a written report, handover, retrospective or analysis
document.reference: reference documentation of an API, a module, a configuration or a command
document.legal: a license, notices, terms, a policy
document.index: a table of contents, a ledger of numbers, or a list pointing at other documents
document.other: a document that fits none of the kinds above

not-a-document.code: source code or a script in any language (a shell hook, a patch, a build file)
not-a-document.config: configuration for a tool, a build, a deployment or a service (a Dockerfile, a unit file, an nginx example, a manifest)
not-a-document.data: structured data or a data file with no prose (a column header, a path list, a source map, an export)
not-a-document.template: a fill-in template or a blank form (an issue template, a letter template, a page template with placeholders)
not-a-document.generated: machine-generated or build output kept in the repository (a minified file, a source map, a lock file)
not-a-document.empty: an empty or placeholder file with no content (a .gitkeep, a one-line note)
